'''''Bellevalia romana''''' is a species of perennial herb in the family [[Asparagaceae]]. It have a self-supporting growth form. Individuals can grow to 22 cm.<ref>{{Cite web|title=''Bellevalia romana'' (L.) Sweet - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/1086209|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org|archive-date=2022-02-07|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220207212135/https://eol.org/pages/1086209|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=''Bellevalia romana'' (Roman Hyacinth) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/ASPG/Bellevalia_romana.php|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us|archive-date=2021-12-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211227184244/https://www.maltawildplants.com/ASPG/Bellevalia_romana.php|url-status=live}}</ref> The species is native to Europe and Egypt.<ref name=POWO/>
